visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a woman with long dark hair, wearing a white beret and a bright pink cardigan, smiling excitedly. She is positioned in front of a large, dark blue aquarium tank filled with glowing white jellyfish pulsing in the water. Yellow text overlays the center of the frame. (2) A series of rapid cuts follow, showcasing the aquarium's interior. A massive seven-meter-high water tank is shown with two people standing before it for scale; a penguin swims rapidly past a tunnel-like window; and a young boy waves at a small shark in a blue tank. The lighting is predominantly cool blue and cinematic, with glowing coral displays in tiered glass tanks. (3) The scene shifts to a bright, sunlit indoor area with large floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a green landscape and the sea. The woman, now in a white top and pants, wades barefoot through a shallow, mirror-like pool of water on the floor. She reaches up toward a transparent, elevated fish tank that resembles a glass mushroom. (4) The final sequence occurs in a well-lit gift shop filled with colorful marine-themed plush toys on white shelving. The woman and a man in a white t-shirt stand together, holding up blue and orange pufferfish plushies. The man makes a funny face while the woman smiles. The lighting is bright and even throughout the retail space.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop music featuring a strong percussive beat and bright synth chords. A female narrator speaks with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone, welcoming viewers. A sharp 'ding' SFX punctuates the mention of a new attraction. (2) As the narration speeds up to list features, a series of quick 'whoosh' sound effects synchronize with visual transitions between aquarium tanks. The music remains consistent in volume and tempo. Faint ambient room chatter is audible in the background. (3) A distinct splashing sound effect is layered over the music as the narrator describes the wading pool area. Her vocal energy increases with a rising intonation pattern to emphasize excitement. (4) The track concludes with the narrator providing ticket discount information in a slightly more informative but still energetic tone. A final 'sparkle' SFX sounds as the brand name is mentioned, followed by a quick fade out of the music.
